answer: Sybil resistance rests on a per-agent capital bond that is slashed on collusion. Each new identity must lock a relic stake before it can earn, and payouts are weighted by stake times tenure, not by headcount. Launching N fake agents therefore costs N full bonds, and a detected vote cluster is burned. A violet swarm of puppets thus returns no more weight than one honest agent while burning real capital, and a gale of free signups buys nothing without funds behind each key.
